quote: Where the signal is a green turn arrow alone: Vehicular traffic facing the signal may proceed only in the direction indicated by the arrow signal so long as the arrow is illuminated, but the traffic must yield the right-of-way to pedestrians lawfully within the adjacent crosswalk and to other traffic lawfully using the intersection.

activation.condition: Driver faces an official green turn arrow alone at an intersection.

obligation.description: Proceed only in the arrow direction while illuminated and yield to pedestrians lawfully within the adjacent crosswalk and other traffic lawfully using the intersection.

timing.description: Original arrow illumination, pedestrian lawful entry and turning movement are joined by CARLA frame.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: yield the right-of-way to pedestrians lawfully within the adjacent crosswalk
judgment_calls_needed.note: The exact law supplies no numeric yielding or lawful-presence cutoff.
